feed.title: World News - Breaking international news and headlines | Sky News

articles.title: British and French paratroopers take part in major wargame in Germany
articles.summary: Over 2,500 British and French troops have taken part in a wargame in Germany designed to show how NATO territory could be defended against an attack.

articles.title: Starlink back to 'the level ⁠we need' in Ukraine, Zelenskyy says
articles.summary: The Starlink satellite system is back to operating at the speed Ukraine needs after slowing down for more than a week, damaging Kyiv's ability to defend itself from Russian attacks, Ukraine's President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said.

articles.title: Bahamas police investigate after British woman dies trying to rescue sons
articles.summary: Police are investigating after a British woman died while trying to rescue her two sons off the Bahamas coast.

articles.title: Vincent Kompany taken to hospital after collapsing at Bayern Munich training
articles.summary: Bayern Munich coach Vincent Kompany has been taken to hospital after collapsing at the club's training ground.

articles.title: Former Olympic marathon champion suspended after failed drugs test
articles.summary: Former Olympic and world marathon champion Peres Jepchirchir has been provisionally suspended after testing positive for the banned substance EPO, officials have said.

articles.title: Israel orders army to prepare to fully close West Bank after two soldiers killed in shooting
articles.summary: The Israeli government has ordered its army to prepare for a full closure of the occupied West Bank following a shooting near Hebron which killed two soldiers.

articles.title: Terrorist shooting in Paris suburb marks 'turning point for France', Macron says
articles.summary: Emmanuel Macron has described the fatal shooting in a Paris suburb as a terrorist and racist attack which "marked a turning point" in the history of France.
